title: Ten malformed board events fail validate_board on every write
description: Five MPI-771 events were written with "event" instead of "type", no "schema", "task" instead of "id" and "note" instead of "summary", into both the global events.jsonl and the card folder. validate_board reports 26 violations, so every board write since prints FAILED and the real signal is lost. validate_board --fix does NOT repair these - it only re-homes orphaned task folders - so the hint task_ops prints on the failure is misleading.
